title: Simmasanam
desc: Sakthivel and Thangarasu are stepbrothers who don't get along with each other. Their differences become more apparent as they start finding out their father's killer.

title: Thanga Manasukkaran
desc: Chellakili and Murugan are long-lost lovers who unite when Murugan visits her village disguised as a musician, Murugesh. Chellakili's aunt then devises a sinister plot to separate them.

title: Mr. Madras
desc: An industrialist hires a young man to settle her disputes with a local criminal on her behalf.
